title: Legacy program oral tradition of agreement with a third party
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Legacy program oral tradition of agreement with a third party, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have learned that it is the oral tradition in the legacy program itself that agreements were struck between the United States and a third party

plain: A man who presents himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, says he has learned of an oral tradition inside the "legacy program", a long-running secret government effort said to deal with non-human intelligence. According to Brown, the story passed down there is that the United States struck agreements with a "third party", meaning a non-human power. If true, it would mean the government made secret deals with non-humans.
